evidence.quote: Retrieves organization members based on the organization ID and the cursor

assumptions: The source lists the organization members response as a bare list of records. I assumed the real response wraps them in a 'data' list with a 'cursor' field, as the other organization endpoints do. Please confirm.
The page size of 100 is a sensible guess. The source does not state a maximum for 'limit'.
The organization id is read from the access token info call (organization.id). This assumes the token belongs to an Enterprise organization.
The organization members endpoint is Enterprise only and needs a Company Admin. Other plans will not be able to list users.

The 'active' field is assumed to separate active from deactivated members. Whether deactivated people are returned by default was not confirmed. The endpoint has an 'active' filter, which I left unset.
User type is derived from the role field: external and team-guest roles are mapped to guest, and internal roles to member.
The source does not give creation dates for members, so createdAt is left empty.
The source does not state the rate limit in requests per minute. It only names tiers (Level 3 for this endpoint), so rate limit values are left empty.
Only the OAuth 2.0 authorization code method is documented. It is tied to the admin who authorizes it, so access may stop if that person leaves the company.
The 'organizations:read' scope is the only one needed for this connector. The source lists other scopes for other endpoints.
